articles.summary: Download PDF Frontier Group Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: ULCC) ("Frontier" or the "Company"), parent company of Frontier Airlines, Inc. , today announced that James G. Dempsey , currently the Company's President, has been appointed as Interim Chief Executive Officer, effective as of December 15, 2025 . Barry L. Biffle , the Company's current Chief Executive Officer, will remain with the Company in an advisory capacity until December 31, 2025 . "Jimmy
articles.title: FRONTIER GROUP HOLDINGS, INC. ANNOUNCES CEO TRANSITION
